177:t_1:169.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「No... She was re-adjusted by the $$連邦軍$$ under $$クロノ$$'s command and became the pilot of a black $$ユニコーン$$.」

177:t_1:171.en:
$$宗介$$
「So they plan to throw a same-type machine at $$バナージ$$'s $$ユニコーン$$.」

177:t_1:172.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...In that battle, with help from Captain $$ジンネマン$$ of the $$ガランシェール$$, we managed to rescue $$マリーダ$$, but Ensign $$リディ$$...」

177:t_1:173.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「MIA... He was declared missing in action during the battle.」

177:t_1:176.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「After the battle, Colonel $$シャア$$ returned to the colony with $$マリーダ$$ and the $$ガランシェール$$ crew.」

177:t_1:177.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And then $$フル・フロンタル$$ announced the Declaration of Succession to Earth's Humanity.」

177:t_1:179.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It says that now that the $$地球連邦$$ has been weakened, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ will build relations with the Empire as the rightful successor of Earth's humanity.」

177:t_1:180.en:
$$宗介$$
「So $$ネオ・ジオン$$ has effectively declared surrender and subordination.」

177:t_1:181.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But the people who are terrified of the Empire's overwhelming power will probably accept it.」

177:t_1:184.en:
$$キラ$$
「Behind $$プラント$$'s support for $$ネオ・ジオン$$ lies a connection to the secret of how $$コーディネイター$$s were born.」

177:t_1:185.en:
$$さやか$$
「$$コーディネイター$$s are the genetically modified humans who live in $$プラント$$, right?」

177:t_1:186.en:
$$キラ$$
「That genetic modification was done by the Reformists, who split off from the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives.」

177:t_1:188.en:
$$宗介$$
「Had $$クロノ$$'s reach extended even to that!?」

177:t_1:189.en:
$$シン$$
「$$ナチュラル$$s and $$プラント$$... The conflict between Earth and space was a struggle between the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives and Reformists...」

177:t_1:190.en:
$$キラ$$
「I heard that story from $$ラクス$$ in $$プラント$$...」

177:t_1:191.en:
$$キラ$$
「And $$ラクス$$, who keeps appealing for peace no matter what, is being hunted by $$ザフト$$, which has teamed up with $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

177:t_1:192.en:
$$シン$$
「And $$レイ#pt136$$ has become the Defense Committee Chairman, the head of $$ザフト$$...」

177:t_1:193.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$レイ#pt136$$? You mean that friend of yours I heard about before...」

177:t_1:194.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「His full name is $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$... He's a clone of a certain person, and he hadn't joined $$ザフト$$ because he was recuperating, but...」

177:t_1:195.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Before we knew it, he had gained $$フル・フロンタル$$'s backing and become the head of $$ザフト$$...」

177:t_1:196.en:
$$シン$$
「I... can't understand what $$レイ#pt136$$ is thinking...」

177:t_1:197.en:
$$シン$$
「But he's my friend... So I'll be the one to stop him...!」

177:t_1:198.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「I know, $$シン$$... I'll back you up.」

177:t_1:200.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$アスラン$$ and the others are in $$プラント$$, too. They're protecting $$ラクス$$, so I believe she'll be all right...」

177:t_1:201.en:
$$キラ$$
「So let's concentrate on bringing the fighting to an end.」

177:t_1:202.en:
$$甲児$$
「Understood. We'll give it our all, too.」

177:t_1:203.en:
$$シン$$
(Wait for me, $$レイ#pt136$$... I will talk this out with you, no matter what.)

177:t_1:204.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Ensign $$リディ$$... You sacrificed yourself to save my life...)

177:t_1:205.en:
$$バナージ$$
(The possibility you saved for me... I will never let it go to waste.)

177:t_1:206.en:
$n
(Everyone has firmed up their resolve to fight, each in their own way...)

177:t_1:210.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm sorry. I didn't mean to interrupt your thoughts.」

177:t_1:212.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You don't have to be nervous. I'm not after your $$スフィア$$.」

177:t_1:214.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Let me introduce myself properly. I'm $$セツコ・オハラ$$...」

177:t_1:215.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Just as you sensed, I'm the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the $$悲しみの乙女$$.」

177:t_1:217.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Is it all right if I call you $n, like everyone else?」

177:t_1:219.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Don't be so nervous. I may be a little older, but we're not that far apart in age.」

177:t_1:221.en:
$$メール$$
「That's not it, $$セツコ$$. $n is just embarrassed, I'm sure.」

177:t_1:223.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're a boy after all, $n. The moment you see a beautiful woman, you get like this.」

177:t_1:225.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's no use hiding it. I've thought for a while that you have a weakness for older women, $n.」

177:t_1:230.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Hehe... I thought you'd be more of a delicate type, so this is a bit unexpected...」

177:t_1:231.en:
$$ランド$$
「Naturally. After all, I'm $n's smile master.」

177:t_1:232.en:
$$メール$$
「With Darling's elite training, $n is aiming to shake off that sullen, silent streak, right?」

177:t_1:233.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Then $$ランド$$ must be the best teacher there is.」

177:t_1:236.en:
$n
「There's something I'd like you to teach me too, $$セツコ$$.」

177:t_1:237.en:
$$メール$$
(Could it be...!? The ABCs of love lessons!?)

177:t_1:238.en:
$$ランド$$
(Knock it off, $$メール$$. Miss $$スズネ$$ won't stay quiet about jokes like that.)

177:t_1:240.en:
$n
「I heard from $$シン$$ that you were on the $$連邦軍$$'s combat skills research team.」

177:t_1:241.en:
$n
「Please. I'm asking you to coach my piloting skills.」

177:t_1:242.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...You're a member of $c, so I think you're already fighting well enough, but...」

177:t_1:243.en:
$n
「Well enough isn't enough. I... I want to get stronger.」

177:t_1:244.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Improving your skills any further from here is harder than you can imagine.」

177:t_1:246.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I'm not as strong as Captain $$アムロ$$, but I'm a little confident in my precise piloting.」

177:t_1:247.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That's because my superior drilled me hard on it.」
